page.overview:
Who is Chuck Dinglewood?

Chuck Dinglewood is the deuteragonist of Step Closer, the first story in the book of the same name. He's Pete’s younger brother who, despite his best efforts not to, constantly annoys his older brother.

Chuck has braces and carries around an inhaler in the pockets of his shorts.

Chuck is rather cowardly, afraid of breaking the rules and scarring easily. He is also very curious and nerdy, asking questions constantly to learn more about things. After his parents’ divorce, Chuck tries to keep himself busy by doing things he likes, such as hanging out with friends, playing online video games, and solving puzzles. He tries to be on good terms with Pete, but everything seems to annoy him and the two are constantly fighting and calling each other names. Despite this, Chuck is very forgiving of his brother and tries helping him.

Chuck always goes to Freddy Fazbear's Pizza after school with his friends and his older brother, Pete, who babysits him due to their parent's divorce. One day, while watching him at Freddy’s, he decides to scare Chuck by taking him to the maintenance room to see Foxy. Chuck escapes as Pete tries to start up Foxy, as Chuck is afraid of Foxy. Pete's shirt gets caught on a nail as he tries to catch him. Pete manages to escape and the brothers return home. When they arrive, their mom shows them brochures about being organ donors.
